content: The insurance agent reminded Aditi Mahajan that her health policy will expire due to missed premium payments and that a payment of 15,000 is needed today to reinstate coverage, providing the payment details. Aditi replied that she is facing financial difficulties and asked for a 7‑10 day extension to make the payment, inquiring about feasibility and any additional charges.

action_items: Agent to evaluate and respond to the requested 7‑10 day payment extension and inform about any additional charges.
Customer to make the payment within the granted extension period.
